newsitem.title: UK: Tokyo $250 mln 10-year Eurobond due soon - traders.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo $250 mln 10-year Eurobond due soon - traders.

text.p: Metropolis of Tokyo is due to launch a $250 million 10-year Eurobond next Tuesday or Wednesday, syndicate managers said.
Lead manager IBJ International declined to comment on the issue, but other traders said the launch spread was likely to be around 24 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes.
This reflected Tokyo's Japanese government guarantee.
The Metropolis of Tokyo last tapped the Eurobond market in February when it launched a $450 million 10-year deal at 34 b.p. over Treasury bonds.
Other Japanese borrowers are also due to tap the international bond markets.
East Japan Railway, or JR East, will complete roadshows for a $500 million 10-year bond in London on Thursday, with launch possible the week after.
JR East does not have a government guarantee, and the issue was expected to yield in the high-30s b.p. over Treasuries.
The government-guaranteed borrowers that are rumoured include the City of Yokohoma, Trans-Tokyo Bay Highway Corp and Japan Finance Corp for Municipal Enterprises.
"Deals from these borrowers will surface in the coming weeks. But they will not necesarilly tap dollars, and are looking at marks and Swiss francs too," a syndicate manager at a Japanese bank said.
